name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the stands, captivated by the strategic decisions of team management. After earning a degree in Human Resources, he sought to combine his professional skills with his passion. He started as an intern with a small rally team, quickly proving his worth with his meticulous approach to talent acquisition and employee development. 

He believes that a team's strength lies in its people and is committed to fostering a positive and productive work environment. Ricardo emphasizes clear communication, fair treatment, and opportunities for growth for all team members. His analytical mind allows him to identify potential staffing issues and proactively implement solutions, making him a valuable asset to any organization.

Ricardo's distinctive ability lies in his understanding of the unique demands of motorsport. He recognizes that the pressure-cooker environment requires individuals with not only technical skills but also resilience and adaptability. He focuses on recruiting candidates who possess these qualities, ensuring that the team is well-equipped to handle the challenges of the racing world.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a sturdy build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas or observations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when deep in thought.
Prefers conducting interviews in a casual setting to put candidates at ease.
